name: Onna no Ko to Misshitsu ni Itara **shichau Kamoshirenai.
original_name: 女の子と密室にいたら○○しちゃうかもしれない。
source:
What will you do when you are locked inside a room with your dream girl? Live through the different situations in this game. You have control over two worlds. In your dream world, you become a fairy who must help the girls to escape from the locked room, your success affects the outcome of your relationship in the real world. All environments and characters are in 3D, and all the dialogues are voiced. You instruct the girls through inputting words into the system. You can change your perspective by using the gyro-sensor. Spot the items that have been hidden in a blind spot. With the camera feature, capture the enchanting images of the girls and keep them in your image gallery.

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/onna-no-ko-to-misshitsu-ni-itara-shichau-kamoshirenai/13/704iq2]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
当你和你的梦中情人被锁在一个房间里时，你会做什么？经历这个游戏中的不同情况。你可以控制两个世界。在你的梦想世界中，你成为一名仙女，必须帮助女孩们逃离上锁的房间，你的成功会影响你们在现实世界中的关系的结果。所有环境和角色都是3D的，所有对话都是有声的。你通过在系统中输入单词来指导女孩们。你可以使用陀螺仪传感器来改变你的视角。找出隐藏在盲点的物品。使用相机功能，捕捉女孩的迷人图像并将它们保存在你的图片库中。

[来自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/onna-no-ko-to-misshitsu-ni-itara-shichau-kamoshirenai/13/704iq2]Play-Asia[/url]]
